title: Historic Edgefield Condo | Walk to Nissan & 5 Pts.
description:
Welcome to our spacious East Nashville condo in Historic Edgefield, one of the city's most walkable neighborhoods. Relax on the outdoor patio, stroll to 5 Points for dining and shopping, catch a Titans game at Nissan Stadium, or enjoy live music downtown—all just minutes away. With 2 king bedrooms, 2 full baths, a fully stocked kitchen, and an open living space, it's the perfect home base for your Nashville stay.

The space
This thoughtfully designed condo comfortably accommodates couples, families, and small groups looking for a relaxing home base in East Nashville.

Inside you'll find:

• Two spacious king bedrooms
• Two full bathrooms
• Open living and dining area
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Outdoor patio
• Fast Wi-Fi
• Smart TVs
• Washer & dryer
• Free onsite parking

Whether you're grabbing takeout from one of East Nashville's incredible restaurants or enjoying a quiet evening after exploring Broadway, you'll have everything you need to feel at home.

Why guests love staying here:

✔ Walk to Five Points restaurants, bars, coffee shops and boutiques
✔ Minutes from Nissan Stadium
✔ Quick ride to Broadway and downtown
✔ Two king suites make it ideal for couples traveling together
✔ Quiet neighborhood with easy access to Nashville's best attractions
✔ Spacious layout that's comfortable for longer stays
✔ Sister property available next door available for larger parties - send us a message for the listing

Perfect For:

• Concert weekends
• Titans games
• Couples traveling together
• Friends exploring Nashville
• Families
• Birthday weekends
• Long weekend getaways
• Remote workers looking for extra space

Guest access
Guests have private access to the entire condo and patio. Self-check-in makes arriving easy, whether you're getting in early or after a night downtown.

The door has an illuminated keypad lock, and regular keys are also available.

Other things to note
We are very close to Nissan Stadium and traffic can get congested during Titans home games and concerts.  We are happy to help with alternate routes.
